caveats: Activity is token-resident support, not permanently removable parameters.
Unsigned resident response norms include within-resident channel cancellation, not cancellation between residents.
Empty events get zero mass retention/effective count, not fabricated top-k support.
Geometric counterfactuals keep trained queries fixed and do not measure retraining or perplexity.
All32spaces have separate coordinates; only scalar metrics averaged across spaces.
No hardware speedup measured; CPUFP32 diagnostic is not the CUDA/BF16 validation score.
The evaluation half is a disjoint document sample from the same repeatedly reused development partition, not the reserved test set.
Activity counts use exact positive native gates captured in CPU FP32; support-boundary events can differ from GPU mixed precision.
Geometry and radius statistics cover all 3,488 resident directions; primary query activity statistics use only the evaluation half.
Reference-half activity is used only for fixed rankings and reference/evaluation comparisons; query PCA axes use the reference half.
No raw tokens, source text, document identifiers, checkpoint weights, or full-dimensional query/resident arrays are included in these public artifacts.
method: Primary evaluation256 documents,32positions each; reference256documents for rankings. Whole-document bootstrap1000 draws. CPUFP32 snapshot.

sampling.selection: uniform unique documents with>=65 tokens; one uniformly located whole within-document window;32 unique uniform positions with>=16 preceding tokens
sampling.halves: disjoint documents, first half reference(split0), second half evaluation(split1)
sampling.window_lengths: min(512,document_token_length-1), all>=64; EOS may be a target; no cross-document window
sampling.position_encoding: positions restart at0 for each sampled window; matches model inference context

precision: CPU FP32; Gram contraction FP64; not native GPU BF16

metric_definitions.gate: Native normalized compact-support distance/radius gate, not a probability; zero means outside support.
metric_definitions.response_norm: UNGATED ||sum_c SiLU(up(h))[resident,c]*down[:,resident,c]||_2 across all512 coordinates; exact full-width4x4 Gram. Unsigned contribution mass=gates*response_norms.
metric_definitions.effective_count: Participation ratio: (sum weights)^2 / sum(weights^2); zero when all weights are zero.
metric_definitions.movement: Angular and chord displacement between initial and trained unit-normalized resident directions; not raw parameter movement.
metric_definitions.radius: Euclidean chord-distance support radius on unit-normalized 128-dimensional query/resident vectors.
metric_definitions.window_rms: RMS across every actual token and all512 dimensions in each window; residual_rms is post-attention skip residual, input_rms is particle LayerNorm output.
metric_definitions.confidence_intervals: Percentile bootstrap of evaluation-document means, 1,000 resamples; descriptive sampling uncertainty only, not training-seed uncertainty.

native_window_precision_check.caveat: Same frozen checkpoint and fixed native diagnostic window. CPU FP32 versus native GPU mixed BF16/FP32; not a perplexity replay.
